Core System Modules

Interactive toolsets for Relational Division simulation, compilation, and tracing

6 INTEGRATED SYSTEMS
MOD_01 LIVE ENGINE

Relational Division Operator ($R \div S$)

Interactive workspace to execute 5-step derivation, inspect intermediate tables $T_1 \dots T_5$, and edit relations with inline controls.

Open Workspace →
MOD_02 INTERACTIVE AST

Operator Expression DAG Tree

Visual mathematical operator tree rendering the relational pipeline $\Pi_A(R) - \Pi_A((\Pi_A(R) \times S) - R)$ with clickable inspection nodes.

Inspect DAG Tree →
MOD_03 STEP DEBUGGER

Universal Quantifier Tracer

Single-stepping debugger validating the $\forall y \in S, \langle x, y \rangle \in R$ condition for candidate tuples with checkmarks and failure flags.

Run Step Debugger →
MOD_04 3 PARADIGMS

SQL Code Generation Studio

Generates correlated Double NOT EXISTS, Aggregation GROUP BY / HAVING COUNT, and Set Difference EXCEPT / MINUS.

Open SQL Studio →
MOD_05 CODD PIPELINE

5-Stage Relational Derivation

Complete algebraic breakdown of intermediate relations: Candidate Projection ($T_1$), Cartesian Product ($T_2$), Set Difference ($T_3$), and Disqualification ($T_4$).

Inspect 5 Stages →
MOD_06 8 ASSERTIONS

Automated Test Suite

High-rigor test suite validating empty divisors, single-row relations, composite keys, duplicate sets, and schema mismatch error handling.
